textNotes.text:
On the last jump dont run or dash last second. You want to walk towards the edge and dash a Lil bit before the edge so youre surge dash works then once it launches you then jump and both phases dashes will work. As long as you see the surge animation your phase dodges will work.
If you dash last second your surge animation won't be there and your phase dashes won't work.

If you are having a hard time with the long jump across to kuldra platform:

Phase dash then wait a split second to use your jump. Then use the two pulse dashes. The split second delay seems to get you under the invisible wall. My friend and I both used this methodology to get across. It still works.
